report:
Reviewed all seven implementation entries and thirteen associated tests against the complete alternative_isolation claim. Requirements are isolated candidate inference and canonical publication, order-independent answer reduction, hard knowledge common to every live possibility, compatible value outputs or justified priority, and reconciliation before concurrent conjunct cancellation. The final requirement and exhaustive isolation verification remain explicitly deferred, not implicitly certified by current tests.

The two boundary.rs entries instantiate a fresh stash/egraph for each query and extract branch-specific canonical responses into owned storage. Extraction includes substitutions, output, residual goals and response binder metadata, validates operation/output pairing, and rejects leaked InferVars. It preserves narrowed domain/current-universe information instead of silently reusing an unchanged input identity. In prove.rs, both trait and normalization frames create a fresh candidate state per task, open a local child, extract before discard, and send only stashed responses to aggregation. Trait disjunction can cancel remaining tasks only on unconditional Proven with empty substitution and true residual; this absorption does not choose a value or constrain sibling input. Normalization waits for all candidates, including environment uncertainty and normalization facts. Captured ScopedTasks cancel/drop destroys pending futures; no shared mutable candidate egraph is handed to sibling tasks.

merge.rs sorts/deduplicates completed answers before pairwise conservative subsumption. Apart-renamed response witnesses, directional matching, repeated-witness consistency, universe limits, and domain admission prevent unrelated binders from being confused. Type outputs participate in the same compatibility matching as conditions/substitutions; unlike unconditional Proven, a type output cannot absorb an unknown candidate source. There is no implemented specialization priority asserted here. anti_unify.rs keeps only substitution keys present across every live answer, preserves common constructors/components and explicit shared domains, drops vacuous bare witnesses and inaccessible input references, and adds an unconstrained possibility for incomplete enumeration. This is the documented restricted final hard-hint channel, not the planned full incremental envelope interface.

All eleven merge unit tests were read with their construction helpers. duplicate_identical_yes_is_one_answer asserts Yes after deduplication. final_answer_rules_are_order_independent compares three candidate orderings to the same unconditional result and checks all-Maybe/all-No. general_conditional_answer_subsumes_specific_one checks the remaining substitution is empty. directional_subsumption_binds_only_repeated_consequent_witnesses checks equal tuple components are subsumed and unequal ones remain Maybe. subsumption_witness_cannot_capture_a_newer_rigid_input and distinct_response_domains_do_not_subsume_each_other each assert Maybe. anti_unification_retains_shared_constructor_and_component asserts a tuple hint, retained bool component and one witness; divergent_bare_values_produce_empty_hard_hint asserts both hints and binders empty. merged_bare_hints_preserve_a_common_response_domain and merged_nested_hints_preserve_a_common_response_domain inspect the response witness binder and require Integer. unconditional_type_output_does_not_hide_an_incomplete_source explicitly requires Maybe. These are meaningful reduction-level tests, not source-level proofs of scheduling or cancellation isolation.

The harness test incompatible_normalization_outputs_are_ambiguous_but_identical_outputs_merge parses local trait/impl source, obtains the associated item, constructs an unfiltered Normalize query, and asserts Yes for equal bool outputs and Maybe for bool versus i32. It additionally requires nonempty balanced unordered normalization inspection spans. Captured fixture and symbol helpers demonstrate the production parse/member/solver route; overlapping impl source is deliberately a Sage ambiguity fixture, not a rustc-accepted coherence example. It does not test every schedule or inspect the exact returned type.

The semantic_spec TODO implementation explicitly preserves concurrent conjunction and cancellation isolation work. Its TODO test retains full candidate permutations, failure/cancellation leakage of equality/universe/wakes/obligations, and sibling-information reconciliation. Current prove_conjunction runs sequentially in one child and retries after semantic progress, so there is no implemented concurrent stale-snapshot cancellation protocol to certify. Prerequisites are that protocol and controlled suspension/cancellation fixtures observing all listed effects; the existing final-answer permutations and output tests cover only part of that matrix. Captured solver-guide and architectural-foundations sections confirm this boundary. No new source edits or test executions; only review start/read and source inspections were performed before recording. Central suite results do not discharge the TODO matrix. No additional requested edits.
